text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Did you get enough sleep last night?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Here, let me have a better look at you.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Hmm. The bags under your eyes are<n>slightly fainter
than the other day.<n>Good. That makes me feel a
little<n>better.
choice_data_list: (I'm glad to hear that, but she's—)

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I know that face. You think I'm<n>worrying too much
again, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Well, whose fault do you think it is<n>that I'm
worrying so much in the first<n>place? Hmph.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
In any case, I'm off. It's time to<n>prove how
effective the equation we<n>created is.
